task.title: Show when each machine last answered
task.description:
Machines that stop answering look the same as quiet ones. Show **when each machine last answered**, like "2 min ago", on its card and on the machine's screen.

- Keep the last snapshot while reconnecting
- Say *Showing the last known state* when it is old

reviews.text: Meets the task. The time updates every minute and survives reconnects.

findings.subject: "0 min ago" shows for a few seconds after connecting

handovers.words: claude took over from codex at 14:02: codex hit its 5-hour limit
